host.title: Host name
host.description: Fully qualified domain name under which eLabFTW is published (SITE_URL).

lets_encrypt.title: Let's Encrypt certificate
lets_encrypt.description: Request a valid Let's Encrypt certificate for the host name.

http2https.title: HTTP to HTTPS redirection
http2https.description: Redirect all HTTP requests to HTTPS.

timezone.title: Timezone
timezone.description: TZ database name for PHP and MySQL, e.g. Europe/Berlin.

max_upload_mb.title: Maximum upload size (MB)
max_upload_mb.description: Largest attachment a user may upload (MAX_UPLOAD_SIZE).

ldap_enabled.title: Enable AD/LDAP login
ldap_enabled.description: Allow login with Active Directory / LDAP accounts.

ldap_source.title: Directory
ldap_source.description: domain: a user domain of this cluster (no credentials stored in the module); custom: an LDAP server entered here.

ldap_domain.title: User domain
ldap_domain.description: User domain of the cluster whose users may log in (ldap_source domain).

ldap_group.title: Group
ldap_group.description: Ignored by eLabFTW, which has no user search filter and cannot enforce a group restriction; kept only for the shared settings shape.

ldap_start_tls.title: StartTLS
ldap_start_tls.description: Upgrade an ldap:// connection with StartTLS (eLabFTW ldap_use_tls).

ldap_tls_verify.title: Verify the server certificate
ldap_tls_verify.description: Check the LDAP server certificate (LDAP_TLS_REQCERT demand). Off for self-signed certificates (Samba AD, internal CA).

ldap_schema.title: Directory type
ldap_schema.description: ad (Active Directory, Samba) or rfc2307 (OpenLDAP posixAccount).

ldap_bind_dn.title: Bind DN
ldap_bind_dn.description: Read-only service account used to search the directory.

ldap_bind_password.title: Bind password
ldap_bind_password.description: New password of the service account; empty keeps the stored one. Stored in state/passwords.env.

ldap_user_attribute.title: Login attribute
ldap_user_attribute.description: Attribute matched against the entered login name (sAMAccountName for AD, uid for OpenLDAP). Several attributes may be separated by commas.

ldap_mail_attribute.title: Mail attribute
ldap_mail_attribute.description: Attribute holding the user's e-mail; eLabFTW requires one. On Active Directory with empty mail fields use userPrincipalName.
